enterpriseBrief.headline: What AbarVa knows about Meridian Health
enterpriseBrief.narrative: Business focus: Enterprise Data and Experience Strategy. Technology context: Epic Hyperspace, Epic Clarity, Epic Caboodle, Claims administration platform. Data context: EMR clinical, claims, pharmacy, eligibility. Control context: PHI handling, human-in-the-loop approval, fragmented data governance.
enterpriseBrief.whyItMatters: This gives leaders an orientation layer before they ask Intelligence, Moves, Source, or Tower to make decisions from the enterprise context.

contextConfidence.summary: AbarVa has source-backed context across the major enterprise dimensions. This is strong enough for enterprise orientation and fact-based questions. Relationship depth and measured outcomes still need validation before cross-domain dependency reasoning, sourcing savings, or Tower value claims.
contextConfidence.evidencePosture: 10 evidence references support this preview, with source lineage available in profile drill-downs.
contextConfidence.relationshipDepth: Relationship candidates are visible for review, but should be validated before being treated as dependency truth.

claudeReadyContextPayload.contextSummary:
Tenant: meridian-health
Module: home
Purpose: executive_orientation
Enterprise Knowledge Overview context assembled for home (general_enterprise_context): 10 evidence refs are available; all remain synthetic review evidence until tenant validation and promotion.
Profiles: enterprise:Meridian Health; function:Enterprise Data and Experience Strategy; use_case:Provider-payer enterprise knowledge layer for member experience, clinical operations, finance analytics, and governed AI/data foundation; system:Epic Hyperspace; system:Epic Clarity; system:Epic Caboodle; system:Claims administration platform; system:Genesys Cloud
Key facts: pain_point=Month-end close dashboards slow down because 38 priority reports refresh from five SQL Server finance schemas during the same overnight load window.; pain_point=Vendor spend differs across AP, procurement, and contract repository extracts, so sourcing questions need a reconciled vendor-master rule before Source uses the data.; pain_point=FP&A trusts 42 certified dashboards, but business-unit teams still use 300+ Excel extracts copied from legacy Tableau views.; pain_point=Informatica job failures are resolved manually because the finance mart lacks clear lineage from Oracle ERP subledger jobs to report-level consumers.; pain_point=Databricks Finance Gold is the target path, but cost-center hierarchy, vendor master harmonization, and audit signoff are unresolved.; pain_point=Agents search Salesforce cases, benefits notes, prior-auth status, and claims inquiry screens separately while the member waits on the call.; pain_point=Call transcript intent labels are inconsistent across billing, eligibility, claims status, and prior authorization categories.; pain_point=Genesys call metadata and Salesforce case outcomes are not reliably joined to claims and benefits context.
Relationships: depends_on:Enterprise Data and Experience Strategy connects to Meridian Health for the general_enterprise_context request.; uses:Enterprise Data and Experience Strategy connects to Provider-payer enterprise knowledge layer for member experience, clinical operations, finance analytics, and governed AI/data foundation for the general_enterprise_context request.; depends_on:Enterprise Data and Experience Strategy connects to Epic Hyperspace for the general_enterprise_context request.; uses:Enterprise Data and Experience Strategy connects to Epic Clarity for the general_enterprise_context request.; depends_on:Enterprise Data and Experience Strategy connects to Epic Caboodle for the general_enterprise_context request.; uses:Enterprise Data and Experience Strategy connects to Claims administration platform for the general_enterprise_context request.; depends_on:Enterprise Data and Experience Strategy connects to Genesys Cloud for the general_enterprise_context request.; uses:Enterprise Data and Experience Strategy connects to Salesforce Health Cloud for the general_enterprise_context request.
Metrics: Close report refresh completion by 6:00 AM CT; Certified finance dashboard adoption; Manual reconciliation hours per close cycle; Average handle time by intent; First contact resolution for claims-status calls; After-call work minutes per agent shift
Risks/controls: PHI handling; human-in-the-loop approval; fragmented data governance; relationship validation required before dependency claims
Evidence summary: Oracle ERP Finance GL/AP/AR extract as of 2026-06 synthetic close cycle.; SQL Server Finance Mart schema inventory showing GL, AP, AR, budget, vendor spend, and cost-center schemas.; Informatica finance ETL inventory with 200 nightly jobs and close-window failure notes.; Tableau and Power BI finance dashboard inventory with certified vs shadow-report split.; Finance Gold Data Product design notes for Databricks target certification.
Confidence: good - The cluster has enough semantic depth for dry-run context assembly, but remains synthetic review context with candidate relationship edges.
Known gaps: inconsistent vendor spend definitions; slow close-window dashboards; incomplete lineage from ERP to BI; intent taxonomy drift; CRM-to-claims join gaps; stale knowledge article duplicates; Relationship candidates are preserved for context assembly, but are not treated as validated active graph truth.
Recommended next evidence: source-owner attestation; measured baseline extract; relationship validation; operator promotion review
